item.title: Tube drivers call eight 24-hour strikes, six in run-up to Christmas
item.body: Tube drivers in the RMT union have called eight 24-hour strikes over 16 days, six of them in the run-up to Christmas. The action is in opposition to plans for a four-day week and threatens transport disruption across the capital.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🚇 Tube drivers call eight 24-hour strikes, six in run-up to Christmas

Tube drivers in the RMT union have called eight 24-hour strikes over 16 days, six of them in the run-up to Christmas. The action is in opposition to plans for a four-day week and threatens transport disruption across the capital.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 6 November, 11:50
